headline: Chinese Equities Face Prolonged Downturn Amid Falling Earnings Forecasts
summary: Chinese equities face a prolonged downturn as corporate earnings forecasts continue to be downgraded across major sectors.
why: Corporate earnings projections serve as fundamental drivers for equity valuations and market performance in major economies.

impacts.name: Chinese Equities
impacts.why: Downgraded corporate earnings forecasts undermine investor valuations.

why_moved: Persistent downward revisions to corporate profit projections reduced investor willingness to allocate capital to Chinese stocks.
